Your licence key

Looking up your purchase…

Thank you for buying Thumbless. Save this key — it is what unlocks everything you paid for.

Activate it

  1. Open the Thumbless options page — right-click the extension icon and choose Options, or open the extension's entry in your browser's extensions list.
  2. Sign in, or create an account, in the card at the top. The licence attaches to that account, which is what lets it work on every browser and phone you sign in on rather than only this one.
  3. Paste the key into Have a licence key? and press Redeem.

Premium unlocks immediately, everywhere you are signed in.

Keep the key

Save it somewhere you will still have it in a year — a password manager, or a note. Your receipt from the payment provider is the copy that will outlive any bookmark. This page also works again if you keep its full address; the part after ?txn= is what identifies your purchase.

Something went wrong?

  • "We have not received confirmation of this purchase yet." The payment reached the provider a moment before it reached us. This page retries on its own for about twenty seconds; if it is still waiting after that, reload it.
  • "This purchase was refunded or cancelled." A refunded or charged-back purchase has no working key, by design.
  • "That licence key is already in use on another account." One key belongs to one account — the first account to redeem it keeps it. Sign in as that account.
  • Anything else. Email hasib107040@gmail.com and include your receipt from the payment provider — never your licence key.

Your key and your account are covered by the Terms of Service and the Refund & Cancellation Policy.
